name: Soutuvene, liplatus venettä vasten / Rowing boat, wooden, small waves lapping against the boat, holding still on a lake when fishing, autumn
description:
Puinen vene, puuvene paikoillaan järvellä, kalassa, syksy. Pienet aallot liplattavat venettä vasten.

Äänitetty / Rec: Analoginen nauha, Nagra / Analog tape, Nagra

Paikka/Place: Suomi / Finland / Vihti, Jokikunta
Aika/Date: 01.10.1987

name: Small Boat Wake on River lapping under Wooden Boardwalk
description: The lapping of small waves against the river bank, after a small boat has passed by. A deep reverberating gulping sound is heard underneath a wooden boardwalk. Birds are heard in the background.

name: Maldivian Water Villa Steps
description: The sea lapping against wooden steps of a water villa on a very calm day. Faint sounds of boats, people and a seaplane in the distance. Recorded on Athuruga island in the Maldives.
